grades.reason: The source says "Let the note owner choose who can view or edit shared meeting notes," which matches the claim in subject, strength and scope.
The source says "Show who a note is shared with and let the owner remove access," which states both parts of the claim.
The source says "Let the owner choose whether each person can view or edit a shared document," which states the claim's per-person view-or-edit choice.
The source says "Links that give access to anyone with the link should be off by default," which matches the claim's "off by default" with the same "should" strength.

The source says "detect the conflict on the server and tell the second person that the record changed" when two people change the same record "at about the same time," which matches the claim word for word.
